name: Uk Ai Bill Compliance Mcp
description: UK AI Regulation Compliance MCP. Automates audits against the UK AI White Paper five principles (safety, transparency, fairness, accountability, contestability), upcoming AI (Regulation) Bill frontier-model obligations, Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard, and sector-regulator guidance (ICO, FCA, MHRA, CMA, Ofcom, HSE). HMAC-signed readiness attestations for UK public-sector + CCS / Digital Marketplace procurement. By MEOK AI Labs.
